replaced.en: File(s) could not be loaded from the given file URL parameter. Loaded sample files instead.
replaced.zh: 无法从 URL 参数加载文件. 已改为加载示例文件.

replaced.zh: 无法恢复之前加载的文件与设置. 已改为加载示例文件.

replaced.en: The previous state could not be fully restored after loading the page. The following properties were not restored.
replaced.zh: 刷新后无法完全恢复之前的状态. 以下属性未被恢复:

replaced.zh: 这 1 条压平/排除规则

⟦0⟧ removed and every file comes back onto the map. Metrics, colors and the camera are left alone.
replaced.zh: ⟦0⟧被移除, 所有文件都会回到地图上. 指标, 颜色和视角保持不变.

replaced.en: ⟦0⟧ of ⟦1⟧ words fit — enlarge the window, reduce word spacing, or enable "Fit all words" or "Draw outside bounds"
replaced.zh: ⟦0⟧ / ⟦1⟧ 个单词已放下 — 请放大窗口, 调小单词间距, 或启用 "放下全部单词" 与 "画出边界绘制"

replaced.en: No Node Area for Chosen Metric
In a cycle with other files
In a cycle inside this file
Display the labels of the ⟦0⟧ highest buildings
replaced.zh: 显示最高的 ⟦0⟧ 栋建筑的标签

replaced.en: ⟦0⟧ visible · ⟦1⟧ with no area in current metric
replaced.zh: ⟦0⟧ 个可见 · ⟦1⟧ 个在当前指标下无面积

replaced.en: Folders nest inside each other and every bit of floor is used.
replaced.zh: 文件夹相互嵌套, 地面被完全利用.

replaced.en: Folders become streets, files line up along them.
replaced.zh: 文件夹变成街道, 文件沿街排列.

replaced.en: Streets for the upper folders, treemaps near the files.
replaced.zh: 上层文件夹用街道, 靠近文件处用矩形树图.

replaced.en: Folders as rings around the centre, drawn flat without heights.
replaced.zh: 文件夹为中心周围的圆环, 平面绘制, 无高度.

replaced.en: A band per folder level, each folder filled with a treemap of its contents.
replaced.zh: 每个文件夹层级一条带, 每个文件夹用矩形树图填满其内容.

replaced.en: Folders are one grey. Pick a value to tint them again.
replaced.zh: 文件夹现在是同一种灰色. 选择一个数值即可重新着色.

replaced.en: Files keep their colour. Folders are tinted by this value; the cog sets neutral or the tint strength.
replaced.zh: 文件保持自身颜色. 文件夹按此数值着色; 齿轮图标设置中性色或着色强度.

replaced.en: One spot on each side for the edges leaving and one for those arriving
replaced.zh: 左右两侧各一个汇聚点, 分别接出边和入边

replaced.en: Each edge with its own spot on the box
replaced.zh: 每条边在方块上各占一个点

replaced.en: Upward edges bow out to the right of the boxes, downward ones to the left
replaced.zh: 向上的边从方块右侧绕行, 向下的从左侧绕行

replaced.en: Leave and enter each box square to its side
A straight line from box to box
Width grows with the dependencies an edge stands for
replaced.zh: 线的宽度随其代表的依赖数量增长

replaced.en: Every edge a hairline, easiest to see through
replaced.zh: 每条边都是发丝线, 最容易看穿

replaced.en: Grows with the dependencies, twice as pronounced
replaced.zh: 随依赖数量增粗, 粗细加倍

replaced.en: Dashed where an edge points upward without closing a cycle
replaced.zh: 向上且不成环的边显示为虚线

replaced.en: Dashes and arrowhead tell how one declaration uses the other
replaced.zh: 虚线与箭头表示声明间的使用方式

replaced.en: Drag or use the arrow keys to resize, double-click to reset
replaced.zh: 拖动或用方向键调整宽度, 双击恢复默认

replaced.en: Number of Code Lines with Comments
Average Number of Commits from this file
replaced.zh: 此文件的平均提交次数

replaced.en: Number of Code Lines covered by tests
Number of Smells Sonar has identified
replaced.zh: Sonar 识别出的坏味道数量

replaced.en: Average Number of Lines added or removed from this file
replaced.zh: 此文件的平均增删行数

replaced.en: Number of Authors that have edited this file
replaced.zh: 编辑过此文件的作者数量

replaced.en: Preview the edges of up to ⟦0⟧ buildings with the highest amount of incoming and outgoing edges
replaced.zh: 预览出入边最多的前 ⟦0⟧ 栋建筑的边

replaced.en: All files added up. Big folders turn red.
replaced.zh: 全部文件求和. 大文件夹偏红.

replaced.en: Its highest file. Never hides a high value.
replaced.zh: 取其中最大文件. 不会掩盖高值.

replaced.en: Its lowest file. Never hides a low value, e.g. with inverted colors.
replaced.zh: 取其中最小文件. 不会掩盖低值, 例如颜色反转时.

replaced.en: Its middle file. Shows the typical file.
replaced.zh: 取其中位文件. 代表典型文件.

replaced.en: Sum divided by the number of files.
Weighted by the area metric, so bigger slices count more.
replaced.zh: 按面积指标加权, 面积大的文件权重更高.
按面积加权的文件均值

replaced.en: File has no checksum, and the browser can only compute one when CodeCharta is opened via https or localhost.
replaced.zh: 文件没有校验和; 只有通过 https 或 localhost 打开 CodeCharta 时浏览器才能计算校验和.

replaced.en: API Version is empty or invalid.
API Version Outdated: Update CodeCharta API Version to match cc.json.
replaced.zh: API 版本过旧: 请更新 CodeCharta API 版本以匹配 cc.json.

replaced.en: Node names in combination with node types are not unique.
replaced.zh: 节点名与节点类型的组合不唯一.

replaced.en: Dependency edge dropped: an endpoint id does not resolve to a node.
replaced.zh: 依赖边已丢弃: 端点 id 无法解析到节点.

replaced.en: Domain lens word bank dropped: the node id does not resolve to a node.
replaced.zh: 领域透镜词库已丢弃: 节点 id 无法解析到节点.

replaced.en: The nodes array is empty. At least one node is required.
replaced.zh: 节点数组为空, 至少需要一个节点.

replaced.en: If at least one direct sub-folder of root is marked as fixed, all direct sub-folders of root must be fixed.
replaced.zh: 根目录下只要有一个直接子文件夹被固定, 所有直接子文件夹都必须固定.

replaced.en: Coordinates of fixed folders must be within a range of 0 and 100.
replaced.zh: 固定文件夹的坐标必须在 0 到 100 之间.

replaced.en: Fixated folders may not be defined in API-Version < 1.2.
replaced.zh: API 版本低于 1.2 时不能定义固定文件夹.

replaced.en: Excluding all buildings is not possible.
File contains unsupported 'authors' attribute. This attribute will be ignored. Node containing the attribute:
replaced.zh: 文件包含不支持的 'authors' 属性, 该属性将被忽略. 含该属性的节点:

replaced.en: Dependency graph with ⟦0⟧ files and ⟦1⟧ edges shown, arranged in rows by level.
replaced.zh: 依赖图: 显示 ⟦0⟧ 个文件与 ⟦1⟧ 条边, 按层级分行排布.

replaced.en: Excluding all buildings is not possible.

replaced.zh: ⟦1⟧ 规则已全部移除, 共 ⟦0⟧ 条
其影响的每个文件都会⟦0⟧

replaced.en: Select this node on the metrics map
replaced.zh: 在指标地图上选中此节点

replaced.en: Show the domain words below this node
replaced.zh: 显示此节点下的领域词

replaced.en: Show this node in the dependency graph
replaced.zh: 在依赖图中显示此节点

replaced.en: On — words that do not fit are shrunk until they do, so the full word count is drawn. Tail words can render below Smallest Word.
replaced.zh: 开 — 放不下的单词会被缩小直到放下, 因此全部单词都会绘制. 排尾的单词可能小于最小单词尺寸.

replaced.en: Off — words that do not fit are left out, so Smallest Word is exact but fewer words than requested appear.
replaced.zh: 关 — 放不下的单词直接舍弃, 最小单词尺寸因此精确, 但实际显示的单词比请求的少.

replaced.en: On — words may render partially outside the layout area instead of being dropped or shrunk, so more words fit at their true size.
replaced.zh: 开 — 单词可以部分画出版面之外, 不再被舍弃或缩小, 更多单词能按真实大小放下.

replaced.en: Off — every word is kept fully inside the layout area; words that only fit overlapping the edge are shrunk or left out.
replaced.zh: 关 — 所有单词都完整放在版面内; 只有压着边缘才放得下的单词会被缩小或舍弃.

replaced.en: Something is wrong with the loaded file(s)
This file has no domain-language data — switched to the map view.
replaced.zh: 此文件没有领域语言数据 — 已切换到地图视图.

replaced.en: Left compare mode — the domain view shows a single word cloud.
replaced.zh: 已退出对比模式 — 领域视图只显示单个词云.

replaced.en: This file has no dependency data — switched to the map view.
replaced.zh: 此文件没有依赖数据 — 已切换到地图视图.

replaced.en: That file is not an SVG.
An SVG that references another file cannot be used as a shape.
replaced.zh: 引用其他文件的 SVG 不能用作形状.

replaced.en: That SVG states neither a size nor a viewBox, so it has no shape to fill.
replaced.zh: 该 SVG 未声明尺寸和 viewBox, 没有可填充的形状.

replaced.en: An SVG carrying a <⟦0⟧> cannot be used as a shape.
replaced.zh: 携带 <⟦0⟧> 的 SVG 不能用作形状.

replaced.en: Leave the focus and show every folder
replaced.zh: 取消聚焦并显示所有文件夹

replaced.en: Click to go up one folder
replaced.zh: 点击返回上一级文件夹

replaced.en: Click to unfocus and go up one folder
replaced.zh: 点击取消聚焦并返回上一级

replaced.en: ⟦0⟧ hidden from the cloud and the word list
replaced.zh: ⟦0⟧ 个词已从词云和词表中隐藏

replaced.en: Show the dependency graph, arranged by level
replaced.zh: 显示按层级排布的依赖图

replaced.en: The focused folder carries no words.
replaced.zh: 聚焦的文件夹没有单词.

replaced.en: The files in the folders they lie in
replaced.zh: 文件按其所在文件夹归组

replaced.en: The files in the packages their declarations declare
replaced.zh: 文件按其声明所属的包归组
解除高度与颜色指标联动

replaced.en: Firefox does not support copying to clipboard
replaced.zh: Firefox 不支持复制到剪贴板

replaced.en: Take a screenshot of the ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ (copy to clipboard) or ⟦2⟧ (save as file)
replaced.zh: 截取 ⟦0⟧: 按 ⟦1⟧ 复制到剪贴板, 或按 ⟦2⟧ 保存为文件

replaced.en: Take a screenshot of the ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧ (save as file) or ⟦2⟧ (copy to clipboard)
replaced.zh: 截取 ⟦0⟧: 按 ⟦1⟧ 保存为文件, 或按 ⟦2⟧ 复制到剪贴板

replaced.en: Points upward and closes a cycle
Visualize code size using real lines of code
replaced.zh: 用实代码行数展示代码规模
展示每函数最大复杂度

replaced.en: Visualize the number of authors per file
replaced.zh: 展示每文件的作者数量

replaced.en: You are focused on "⟦0⟧", so there is no folder above it. Unfocus and go up one folder?
replaced.zh: 当前聚焦于 "⟦0⟧", 其上没有文件夹. 取消聚焦并返回上一级文件夹吗?

replaced.en: TF-IDF (relative importance) — sizes words by how distinctive they are, not by raw count
replaced.zh: TF-IDF (相对重要性) — 按单词的区分度而非出现次数决定大小

replaced.en: TF-IDF (relative importance) — not available: the loaded file has no TF-IDF scores
replaced.zh: TF-IDF (相对重要性) — 不可用: 加载的文件没有 TF-IDF 分数
